category: usenet provider (German, volume subscriptions and 5-year prepaid accounts)

free_tier.stated: Free demo account: 0.5 Gigabyte for 7 days at EUR 0.00, confirmed with a free SMS code to a mobile phone; one new demo per phone number and email address every 90 days.
free_tier.notes: The demo needs a mobile number; a landline works through a hang-up call to a stated number.

retention.stated: 1600 days of Usenet retention ('1600 Tage Usenet Retention')

egress.terms: Monthly volume of 25, 75 or 150 GB, or flat rates of 1, 4 or 16 Mbit/s; 5-year accounts of 25 to 500 GB

interface_detail: NNTP; the vendor page names a Usenet server per account
chaining: The 5-year accounts do not renew: 25 GB for EUR 10.00 up to 500 GB for EUR 100.00, so a bulk block can be held for years.

limits.value: 25, 75 and 150 GB per month; 5-year accounts of 25, 100, 200 and 500 GB

limits_note: Monthly: 25 GB EUR 5.95, 75 GB EUR 13.95, 150 GB EUR 23.95; flat rates 1 Mbit/s EUR 11.95, 4 Mbit/s EUR 18.95, 16 Mbit/s EUR 29.95. EU prices include VAT.
binding_note: Every paid product is a fixed volume or a speed-capped flat; the demo is 0.5 GB.

identity_cost.detail: The demo sends 'a free SMS code to your mobile phone which you have to confirm on this page'; a landline is accepted by a hang-up call. The paid order form was not opened: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the vendor pages read.
